scope: All-field compact rational leading-coordinate theorem for both central arms. Unit numerators allow arbitrary compatible outer images; nonunit numerators require matching outer images in the central multiplication image. Scalar rational unit one-arm corollary permits an arbitrary opposite arm. No unrestricted endpoint or exact novelty claimed.

uniform_result.hypotheses: P,Q have nonzero constants, total degrees p,r<A and nonzero pure q^p,q^r coefficients
uniform_result.heavy_endpoint_strip: M<=3t+d or |M-a|<=3t+d, except the rational price plane
uniform_result.scalar_one_arm: O(n^2*(1+d/t+log(a/t))^2), arbitrary compatible opposite and outer images
uniform_result.nonunit_extension: The same quadratic bound holds with Q unit and matching outer components f0Y=W_Y*B_Y, f2Z=W_Z*B_Z on each nonunit arm; cross outer components remain arbitrary.
uniform_result.geometric_family: W=1+v/(1-q) has compact degree 1 and expanded forward/inverse degrees A-1; both such arms give a quadratic full fan

limits: Both arms require the compact rational triangle hypotheses for the quadratic theorem; one such arm controls its heavy sector.
Nonunit numerators require the matching outer-image condition; zero outer images satisfy it. Unit arms allow every compatible outer coefficient.
The scalar rational one-arm corollary permits arbitrary opposite coefficients and has the displayed logarithmic allowance.
Loop identities and prefix coloops retain original labels; denominator multiplication is an invertible row operation, not an algebra coordinate change.
Small expanded or inverse degree is not assumed; general units need not have compact representations of this form.
Strongest-current novelty, sharp unrestricted growth, actual polynomial fan separation and the original final paper remain unresolved.
